about_the_game:
NOTE! This is an In-Development Early version of the game, if you have issues with the game you can leave a bug report in Discord or feedback with the in-game form.

  • TAME RIDABLE PETS

Tame any animal with the lasso mini-game to gain a companion that you can level-up, ride into battle, and fight along-side! They even have elemental pet abilities...

  • EXPLORE INFINITE BIOMES

Explore an endless procedural fantasy world, discover the depth of biomes filled with living creatures, villagers, and natural features... to find all the hidden secrets.

  • CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER

Roleplay and design your character from 5 different fantasy species, face, hair and body shapes. Then level up and specialize in your class unlocking skills in the skill tree.

  • MASTER YOUR WEAPONRY

Fast-paced dynamic combat featuring different weapon types, dash-dodging, and a charged/mana ability system. Combat emenies with special elemental abilties and behaviors.

  • QUEST & TRADE

The main quest depicts the struggle between civilization and nature through choices that lead to different boss fights and allegiances. Eventually, these choices will impact the World of Wildaria. Villagers and bandits populate camps, villages and ruins. Converse, quest, trade, and even wager some coin in a game of Trailsweeper with the townsfolk!

  • BATTLE GODS

Delve deep into procedural dungeons defend yourself from dangerous wildlife, encounter larger-than-life animal Gods, and acquire epic loot.

  • DISCOVER SECRETS

Good luck finding them...

INSPIRATIONS

GBA Era

The pixel art graphics are inspired by GBA Era titles such as Zelda, Sword of Mana, Pokemon Emerald, but with modern computer-rendered shaders for a more natural wind-swept foliage and water graphics. The Gameplay is a more modern take on action-adventure RPG's from the GBA era with endless replayability lent from the procedural nature of the world, loot, and enemies.

Local Wildlife

As a solo game developer, maintaining self-motivation and inspiration can be challenging. I read about how Shigeru Miyamoto based the original Zelda on exploring the Japanese countryside with his father. I realized "That rather than make a game like Zelda, I needed to make a game like Zelda was made." I've always loved nature- from hiking, to observing local animals or plants, to just laying in the dirt. I guarantee you will discover something new and fascinating if you just look closely and give the smallest bug or flower the time of day.

My Life Mission is to create worlds for others to explore and lose themselves in, while inspiring others to venture out into their local wildlife.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2.
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Additional Notes: Apple officially supported drivers. For development: IL2CPP scripting backend requires Xcode. Targeting Apple Silicon with IL2CPP scripting backend requires macOS Catalina 10.15.4 and Xcode 12.2 or newer.

name: Wildaria Pre-Alpha

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable.
  • Additional Notes: Hardware vendor officially supported drivers. For development: IL2CPP scripting backend requires Visual Studio 2015 with C++ Tools component or later and Windows 10 SDK.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Tame pets to explore an infinite fantasy world. Adventure through procedural biomes meeting unique characters that send you on quests to conquer dungeons and slay animal gods. Customize your character, combat style, and level up in this Action-Adventure RPG.
